payload.value: macOS uses Swift 6 package targets and domain-split Swift files (AppModel+..., AgentBridge+...); UI is SwiftUI and core models/host use Observation with main-actor isolation for app state. Tests are XCTest in macos/DotsHarness/Tests/HarnessPluginKitTests, imported with @testable; run from macos/DotsHarness using swift test (package target in Package.swift).
